remarks: Sunny and Bright One Bedroom - Walk to all that East Norwalk and Sono has to offer!!! Conveniently located to Metro North and I95/RT 7 Connector making commuting a breeze. Veteran's Park, Calf Pasture Beach, numerous restaurants and the "Sono Collection" Mall all within walking distance. First floor unit, recently painted and ready for occupancy. 1 car off-street parking included with additional rear entrance and small deck. No smoking/No pets/No electric bikes or scooters. Good Credit, References, Proof of Household Income, Photo ID and 2 months security required. Schedule your appointment to preview today!
